summary: Rectitude Holdings filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a press release dated September 17, 2026, announcing its participation in OS+H Asia held September 9-11, 2026, at the Sands Expo Convention Centre in Singapore. The Company showcased its SuperSun AIMS SS250 and SS500 micro-grid energy storage systems and launched the SS02-16E battery system, SS-PV-Station solar array, smart microgrid controllers, and AI monitoring solutions. No transaction, equity stake, price per share, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed. The event drew over 5,800 trade visitors from 40 countries and 130 exhibitors; no risk-arb angle exists.
